Bấm Xem bản nháp để xem file PDF sẽ được: Click Preview draft to see the PDF that will be exported. Once everything is filled in, click Create report to download it. If anything is missing, the system lists each item and takes you straight to where it needs to be filled in.
Bộ câu hỏi chia thành ba phần Môi trường: The questionnaire is divided into three parts, Environmental, Social and Governance, each with several groups. Every question has answer options. Some options require a description and supporting files (PDF or images).
Điền tên, lĩnh vực, quy mô nhân sự, địa: Fill in the name, sector, headcount, address, reporting period and reporting year in the left column.
Hệ thống tự lưu khi bạn trả lời xong một: The system saves automatically when you finish a group, or you can click Save draft at any time. Next time you open the site in the same browser, you continue where you left off. Evidence files are not stored in the draft, so you will need to upload them again.
Hồ sơ tự khai phục vụ quản lý nội bộ, qu: Self-declared dossiers are for internal management only. If you need an ESG dossier verified by a reputable organization for export purposes, please contact:
Sau khi xuất báo cáo, bấm Làm báo cáo mớ: After exporting the report, click Start new report in the Progress panel to clear all content and begin again from scratch.
